members.name: kColorSyncAlphaNone
members.doc: There is no alpha channel. For example, RGB.

members.name: kColorSyncAlphaPremultipliedLast
members.doc: The alpha component is stored last and the color components are premultiplied by it. For example, premultiplied RGBA.

members.name: kColorSyncAlphaPremultipliedFirst
members.doc: The alpha component is stored first and the color components are premultiplied by it. For example, premultiplied ARGB.

members.name: kColorSyncAlphaLast
members.doc: The alpha component is stored last and is not premultiplied. For example, non-premultiplied RGBA.

members.name: kColorSyncAlphaFirst
members.doc: The alpha component is stored first and is not premultiplied. For example, non-premultiplied ARGB.

members.name: kColorSyncAlphaNoneSkipLast
members.doc: There is no alpha channel; the least significant bits are ignored. For example, RGBX.

members.name: kColorSyncAlphaNoneSkipFirst
members.doc: There is no alpha channel; the most significant bits are ignored. For example, XRGB.

ColorSyncAlphaInfo.doc: The location of the alpha component in a pixel, and whether it's premultiplied.

members.name: kColorSync1BitGamut
members.doc: One-bit values, used for gamut-check results.

ColorSyncDataDepth.doc: The bit depth and numeric type of a color component in a pixel.

ColorSyncCMM.doc: A reference to a Color Management Module (CMM). This type is a lightweight wrapper around a Core Foundation bundle.

ColorSyncMD5.doc: An MD5 digest that uniquely identifies a profile, as defined by the ICC specification.

ColorSyncProfile.doc: A reference to an immutable International Color Consortium (ICC) color profile.

ColorSyncTransform.doc: A reference to a color transform that converts color data between profiles.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileGetTypeID
functions.doc: Returns the unique identifier for the ColorSync profile opaque type. - Returns: The `CFTypeID` for `ColorSyncProfile` objects.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCreate
functions.doc: Creates a profile from ICC profile data. - Parameters: - data: The ICC profile data. - error: On failure, a pointer to an error describing the problem. Optional. - Returns: A new profile, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCreateWithURL
functions.doc: Creates a profile from ICC profile data at a URL. - Parameters: - url: The URL to the profile data. - error: On failure, a pointer to an error describing the problem. Optional. - Returns: A new profile, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCreateWithURLAndOptions
functions.doc: Creates a profile from ICC profile data at a URL, using the given options. - Parameters: - url: The URL to the profile data. - options: A dictionary with creation options, for example ``kColorSyncDoNotSubstituteProfiles``. - error: On failure, a pointer to an error describing the problem. Optional. - Returns: A new profile, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCreateWithName
functions.doc: Creates a profile from a predefined profile name. - Parameter name: The predefined profile name. - Returns: A new profile, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCreateWithDisplayID
functions.doc: Creates a profile for the specified display. - Parameter displayID: The system-wide unique display ID (defined by IOKit); pass `0` for the main display. - Returns: A new profile, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCreateDeviceProfile
functions.doc: Creates a profile for a device registered with ColorSync. See `ColorSyncDevice.h` for more information on `deviceClass`, `deviceID`, and `profileID`. - Parameters: - deviceClass: The ColorSync device class. - deviceID: The device ID registered with ColorSync. - profileID: The profile ID registered with ColorSync; pass ``kColorSyncDeviceDefaultProfileID`` to get the default profile. - Returns: A new profile, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCreateMutable
functions.doc: Creates an empty mutable profile. - Returns: An empty mutable profile, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCreateMutableCopy
functions.doc: Creates a mutable copy of a profile. - Parameter prof: The profile whose data the function copies into the new mutable profile. - Returns: A new mutable profile, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCreateLink
functions.doc: Creates a device link profile from an array of profiles. Each dictionary in `profileInfo` contains a profile object and information on the usage of the profile in the transform. Required keys: - ``kColorSyncProfile``: A ``ColorSyncProfileRef``. - ``kColorSyncRenderingIntent``: A `CFStringRef` defining the rendering intent. - ``kColorSyncTransformTag``: A `CFStringRef` defining which tags to use. Optional key: - ``kColorSyncBlackPointCompensation``: A `CFBooleanRef` to enable or disable black point compensation. - Parameters: - profileInfo: An array of dictionaries, each containing a profile object and the information on the usage of the profile in the transform. - options: A dictionary with additional public global options (for example, preferred CMM, quality, and so on). It can also contain custom options that are CMM specific. - Returns: A new profile, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileVerify
functions.doc: Verifies whether a profile can be used. - Parameters: - prof: The profile to verify. - errors: Returns error strings in case problems are found that would prevent use of the profile. - warnings: Returns warning strings indicating problems due to lack of conformance with the ICC specification, but not preventing use of the profile. - Returns: `true` if the profile can be used; otherwise, `false`.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileIsWideGamut
functions.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the display profile describes a wide-gamut color space.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileIsMatrixBased
functions.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the profile is matrix-based.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileIsPQBased
functions.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the profile uses ITU BT.2100 PQ transfer functions.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileIsHLGBased
functions.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the profile uses ITU BT.2100 HLG transfer functions.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileEstimateGammaWithDisplayID
functions.doc: Estimates the gamma of the profile for the specified display. - Parameters: - displayID: The system-wide unique display ID (defined by IOKit). - error: On failure, a pointer to an error describing the problem. Optional. - Returns: A non-zero value on success, or `0.0` in case of error.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileGetDisplayTransferFormulaFromVCGT
functions.doc: Converts the profile's `vcgt` tag to formula components used by `CGSetDisplayTransferByFormula`. The function performs this conversion only if a `vcgt` tag exists in the profile and the conversion is possible.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCreateDisplayTransferTablesFromVCGT
functions.doc: Creates display transfer tables from the profile's `vcgt` tag. Creates three tables of floats (a red table, a green table, and a blue table), each of size `nSamplesPerChannel`, packed into contiguous memory contained in the returned `CFDataRef`, from the `vcgt` tag of the profile (if a `vcgt` tag exists in the profile). `CGSetDisplayTransferByTable` uses these tables.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileEstimateGamma
functions.doc: Estimates the gamma of a profile. - Parameters: - prof: The profile to perform estimation on. - error: On failure, a pointer to an error describing the problem. Optional. - Returns: A non-zero value on success, or `0.0` in case of error.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileGetMD5
functions.doc: Returns the MD5 digest for a profile. - Parameter prof: The profile to compute the digest for. - Returns: The MD5 digest for the profile, calculated as defined by the ICC specification, or a "zero" signature (filled with zeros) in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCopyData
functions.doc: Copies the flattened data from a profile. - Parameters: - prof: The profile to copy the flattened data from. - error: On failure, a pointer to an error describing the problem. Optional. - Returns: The profile data on success, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileGetURL
functions.doc: Returns the URL of a profile. - Parameters: - prof: The profile to get the URL from. - error: On failure, a pointer to an error describing the problem. Optional. - Returns: The profile's URL on success, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCopyHeader
functions.doc: Copies the header from a profile. - Parameter prof: The profile to copy the header from. - Returns: The profile header (in host endianness), or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileSetHeader
functions.doc: Sets the header of a mutable profile. - Parameters: - prof: The profile in which to set the header. - header: The header data (must be in host endianness).

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCopyDescriptionString
functions.doc: Copies the localized description string of a profile. - Parameter prof: The profile to copy the description string from. - Returns: The profile description, localized to the current locale.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCopyTagSignatures
functions.doc: Copies the tag signatures of a profile. - Parameter prof: The profile to copy tag signatures from. - Returns: An array with the signatures (`CFStringRef`) of the tags in the profile.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileContainsTag
functions.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether a profile contains a given tag. - Parameters: - prof: The profile in which to search for the tag. - signature: The signature of the tag to search for. - Returns: `true` if the tag exists; otherwise, `false`.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCopyTag
functions.doc: Copies a tag from a profile. - Parameters: - prof: The profile to copy the tag from. - signature: The signature of the tag to copy. - Returns: The tag data, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileSetTag
functions.doc: Sets a tag in a mutable profile. - Parameters: - prof: The profile in which to set the tag. - signature: The signature of the tag to set in the profile. - data: The tag data.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileRemoveTag
functions.doc: Removes a tag from a mutable profile. - Parameters: - prof: The profile to remove the tag from. - signature: The signature of the tag to remove.

functions.name: ColorSyncIterateInstalledProfiles
functions.doc: Iterates over the installed profiles. When called for the first time, this function returns only system profiles, because profile iteration is a slow process requiring multiple accesses to the file system. Clients are advised to register for ``kColorSyncProfileRepositoryChangeNotification`` using `CFNotificationCenter` or `NSNotificationCenter` to obtain all installed profiles. The notification callback receives, if possible, a `CFDictionary` containing a new seed value of the profile cache (key ``kColorSyncProfileCacheSeed`` / value `kCFNumberSInt32Type`). Comparing old and new seed values may prevent unnecessary calls to iterate installed profiles. Alternatively, call ``ColorSyncIterateInstalledProfilesWithOptions`` with the ``kColorSyncWaitForCacheReply`` option set to `kCFBooleanTrue` to obtain all installed profiles in one call. - Parameters: - callBack: A pointer to a client-provided function (can be `NULL`). - seed: A pointer to a cache seed owned by the client (can be `NULL`). - userInfo: User-defined data passed to the callback. - error: On failure, a pointer to an error describing the problem. Optional.

functions.name: ColorSyncIterateInstalledProfilesWithOptions
functions.doc: Iterates over the installed profiles, using the given options. - Parameters: - callBack: A pointer to a client-provided function (can be `NULL`). - seed: A pointer to a cache seed owned by the client. - userInfo: User-defined data passed to the callback. - options: A dictionary with iteration options, for example ``kColorSyncWaitForCacheReply`` to wait for the cache to finish updating before returning. - error: On failure, a pointer to an error describing the problem. Optional.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileInstall
functions.doc: Installs a profile in the specified domain. The `domain` is either ``kColorSyncProfileComputerDomain`` or ``kColorSyncProfileUserDomain``. ``kColorSyncProfileComputerDomain`` is for sharing the profiles (from `/Library/ColorSync/Profiles`). ``kColorSyncProfileUserDomain`` is for user custom profiles (installed under the home directory, that is, in `~/Library/ColorSync/Profiles`). `NULL` is the same as ``kColorSyncProfileUserDomain``. The `subpath` is the file system representation of the path of the file to contain the installed profile. The function interprets the last component of the path as a file name if it ends with the extension `.icc`. Otherwise, the function interprets the subpath as the directory path and creates the file name from the profile description tag, appended with the `.icc` extension. Using this function requires `COLORSYNC_PROFILE_INSTALL_ENTITLEMENT`. - Parameters: - profile: The profile to install. - domain: The domain to install into, either ``kColorSyncProfileComputerDomain`` or ``kColorSyncProfileUserDomain``. - subpath: A string created from the file system representation of the path of the file to contain the installed profile. - error: On failure, a pointer to an error describing the problem. Optional. - Returns: `true` on success, or `false` in case of error.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileUninstall
functions.doc: Uninstalls a profile. The profile must return a valid URL for ``ColorSyncProfileGetURL``; that is, it must be created with ``ColorSyncProfileCreateWithURL``. Also, the URL must be in either ``kColorSyncProfileComputerDomain`` or ``kColorSyncProfileUserDomain``, including subfolders of those. Using this function requires `COLORSYNC_PROFILE_INSTALL_ENTITLEMENT`. - Parameters: - profile: The profile to uninstall. - error: On failure, a pointer to an error describing the problem. Optional. - Returns: `true` on success, or `false` in case of error.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCreateCopyWithHeadroomAdaptiveGainCurveMetadata
functions.doc: Returns a copy of a profile with the supplied Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve data embedded as an HAGC tag. - Parameters: - profile: A profile whose CICP tag indicates a PQ, HLG, or linear transfer function. (Use linear for extended-range data.) Passing an SDR profile returns `NULL`. - data: The raw Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve data to embed. Must be non-`NULL`. - options: Reserved for future use. Pass `NULL`. - Returns: A new profile that the caller must release with `CFRelease`, or `NULL` on failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCopyHeadroomAdaptiveGainCurveMetadata
functions.doc: Returns a copy of the raw Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve data embedded in a profile. - Parameter profile: The profile to read the HAGC tag from. - Returns: A copy of the raw HAGC data that the caller must release with `CFRelease`, or `NULL` if the profile contains no HAGC tag.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCreateCopyWithHeadroomAdaptiveGainCurveInfoDictionary
functions.doc: Returns a copy of a profile with an HAGC tag synthesized from an info dictionary. - Parameters: - profile: A profile whose CICP tag indicates a PQ, HLG, or linear transfer function. (Use linear for extended-range data.) Passing an SDR profile returns `NULL`. - info: A dictionary describing the gain curve. See the key constants declared below for its structure. - Returns: A new profile that the caller must release with `CFRelease`, or `NULL` on failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileCopyHeadroomAdaptiveGainCurveInfoDictionary
functions.doc: Returns a dictionary describing the Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve decoded from a profile. - Parameter profile: The profile to decode the HAGC tag from. - Returns: A dictionary describing the gain curve, which the caller must release with `CFRelease`, or `NULL` if the profile carries no HAGC tag. See the key constants declared below for the dictionary's contents.

functions.name: ColorSyncProfileContainsHeadroomAdaptiveGainCurve
functions.doc: Returns whether a profile contains a Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve tag. - Parameter profile: The profile to test. - Returns: `true` if the profile contains an HAGC tag; otherwise, `false`.

functions.name: ColorSyncTransformGetTypeID
functions.doc: Returns the type identifier for the `ColorSyncTransform` opaque type. - Returns: The `CFTypeID` for `ColorSyncTransform` objects.

functions.name: ColorSyncTransformCreate
functions.doc: Creates a color transform from a sequence of profiles. Each dictionary in `profileSequence` contains a profile object and information on the usage of the profile in the transform. Required keys: - ``kColorSyncProfile``: A ``ColorSyncProfileRef``. - ``kColorSyncRenderingIntent``: A `CFStringRef` defining the rendering intent. - ``kColorSyncTransformTag``: A `CFStringRef` defining which tags to use. Optional key: - ``kColorSyncBlackPointCompensation``: A `CFBooleanRef` to enable or disable black point compensation. - Parameters: - profileSequence: An array of dictionaries, each one containing a profile object and the information on the usage of the profile in the transform. - options: A dictionary with additional public global options (for example, preferred CMM, quality, and so on). It can also contain custom options that are CMM specific. - Returns: A new ``ColorSyncTransformRef``, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncTransformCopyProperty
functions.doc: Copies a property from a color transform. - Parameters: - transform: The transform from which to copy the property. - key: A `CFTypeRef` used as a key to identify the property. - options: A dictionary with additional options.

functions.name: ColorSyncTransformSetProperty
functions.doc: Sets a property on a color transform. - Parameters: - transform: The transform in which to set the property. - key: A `CFTypeRef` used as a key to identify the property. - property: The `CFTypeRef` to set as the property.

functions.name: ColorSyncTransformGetProfileSequence
functions.doc: Returns the profile sequence used to create a color transform. - Parameter transform: The transform from which to get the profile sequence used to create the transform.

functions.name: ColorSyncTransformConvert
functions.doc: Converts color data from a source layout to a destination layout using a color transform. Use this function with care for performance reasons. Color conversions are computationally intensive and the recommended way to perform these is by using the vImage converter with a ColorSync code fragment. vImage employs vectorized code which is not only faster but also more battery efficient. Please visit the following link to see a sample application of vImage used in conjunction with ColorSync: <https://developer.apple.com/library/prerelease/content/samplecode/convertImage/Listings/convertImage_main_c.html> More details regarding ColorSync code fragments are included below, as well. - Parameters: - transform: The transform to use for converting color. - width: The width of the image in pixels. - height: The height of the image in pixels. - dst: A pointer to the destination where the function writes the results. - dstDepth: Describes the bit depth and type of the destination color components. - dstLayout: Describes the format and byte packing of the destination pixels. - dstBytesPerRow: The number of bytes in the row of data. - src: A pointer to the data to convert. - srcDepth: Describes the bit depth and type of the source color components. - srcLayout: Describes the format and byte packing of the source pixels. - srcBytesPerRow: The number of bytes in the row of data. - options: A dictionary with additional options. - Returns: `true` if the conversion succeeds, or `false` otherwise.

functions.name: ColorSyncCreateCodeFragment
functions.doc: Creates a code fragment from a sequence of profiles. Each dictionary in `profileSequence` contains a profile object and information on the usage of the profile in the code fragment. Required keys: - ``kColorSyncProfile``: A ``ColorSyncProfileRef``. - ``kColorSyncRenderingIntent``: A `CFStringRef` defining the rendering intent. - ``kColorSyncTransformTag``: A `CFStringRef` defining which tags to use. Optional key: - ``kColorSyncBlackPointCompensation``: A `CFBooleanRef` to enable or disable black point compensation. - ``kColorSyncExtendedRange``: A `CFBooleanRef` to enable or disable extended range; disabling implies floating point conversions. - Parameters: - profileSequence: An array of dictionaries, each one containing a profile object and the information on the usage of the profile in the code fragment. - options: A dictionary with additional options as in the case of creating a `ColorSyncTransform`. - Returns: A `CFTypeRef` representing a ColorSync code fragment, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncCMMGetTypeID
functions.doc: Returns the `CFTypeID` for `ColorSyncCMM`s.

functions.name: ColorSyncCMMCreate
functions.doc: Creates a CMM object from a CMM bundle. - Parameter cmmBundle: The bundle containing the CMM. - Returns: A new ``ColorSyncCMMRef``, or `NULL` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncCMMGetBundle
functions.doc: Returns the bundle associated with a CMM. - Returns: The `CFBundleRef` for the CMM, or `NULL` for the built-in Apple CMM.

functions.name: ColorSyncCMMCopyLocalizedName
functions.doc: Copies the localized name of a CMM. Use this function to get the name of the built-in CMM. - Returns: The localized name of the CMM.

functions.name: ColorSyncCMMCopyCMMIdentifier
functions.doc: Copies the identifier of a CMM. Use this function to get the identifier of the built-in CMM. - Returns: The identifier of the CMM.

functions.name: ColorSyncIterateInstalledCMMs
functions.doc: Iterates over the installed CMMs, invoking a callback for each one. - Parameters: - callBack: A pointer to a client-provided function. - userInfo: A pointer to the user info that the framework passes to the callback. Optional.

functions.name: ColorSyncRegisterDevice
functions.doc: Registers a device of the given class with ColorSync. The `deviceInfo` dictionary requires the following keys: - ``kColorSyncDeviceDescriptions``: A `CFDictionary` with localized names of the device. Localization keys must be five-character strings containing a language code and region code in the `lc_RG` format, and must contain (at least) the `en_US` locale. - ``kColorSyncFactoryProfiles``: A `CFDictionary` of factory profile info dictionaries. The keys are the profile IDs and the values are the profile info dictionaries. It may also include the following optional keys: - ``kColorSyncDeviceHostScope``: The host scope of the device; one of `kCFPreferencesCurrentHost` or `kCFPreferencesAnyHost`. If you don't specify it, the framework assumes `kCFPreferencesCurrentHost`. - ``kColorSyncDeviceUserScope``: The user scope of the device; one of `kCFPreferencesCurrentUser` or `kCFPreferencesAnyUser`. If you don't specify it, the framework assumes `kCFPreferencesCurrentUser`. The factory profiles dictionary (the value for the key ``kColorSyncFactoryProfiles`` in `deviceInfo`) requires the following keys and values. A ProfileID (of `CFStringRef` type) identifies each profile and serves as the key. The value associated with the key is a profile info dictionary that describes an individual device profile. - ``kColorSyncDeviceDefaultProfileID``: The associated value must be one of the ProfileIDs present in the dictionary. Presence of this key is not required if there is only one factory profile. Each profile info `CFDictionary` requires the following keys: - ``kColorSyncDeviceProfileURL``: The `CFURLRef` of the profile to register. - ``kColorSyncDeviceModeDescriptions``: A `CFDictionary` with localized device mode names for the profile. Localization keys must be five-character strings containing a language code and region code in the `lc_RG` format, and must contain (at least) the `en_US` locale. For example, `en_US` "Glossy Paper with best quality". Example of a `deviceInfo` dictionary: << kColorSyncDeviceDescriptions   << en_US  My Little Printer de_DE  Mein Kleiner Drucker fr_FR  Mon petit immprimeur ... >> kColorSyncFactoryProfiles       << CFSTR("Profile 1")  << kColorSyncDeviceProfileURL    {CFURLRef} kColorSyncDeviceModeDescriptions    << en_US Glossy Paper de_DE Glanzpapier fr_FR Papier glace ... >> ... kColorSyncDeviceDefaultProfileID  CFSTR("Profile 1") >> kColorSyncDeviceUserScope   kCFPreferencesAnyUser kColorSyncDeviceHostScope   kCFPreferencesCurrentHost << - Note: Scope for factory profiles is exactly the same as the device scope. - Note: Pass `kCFNull` in lieu of the profile URL, or no URL key/value pair at all, if a factory profile is not available. This enables setting a custom profile. - Note: For compatibility with the legacy API, create the profile keys as `CFString`s from `uint32_t` numbers as follows: `CFStringRef key = CFStringCreateWithFormat(NULL, NULL, CFSTR("%u"), (uint32_t) i);` - Parameters: - deviceClass: The class of the device to register. - deviceID: The identifier of the device to register. - deviceInfo: A dictionary containing the information needed to register a device. - Returns: `true` on success and `false` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncUnregisterDevice
functions.doc: Unregisters a device of the given class and identifier. - Parameters: - deviceClass: The class of the device to unregister. - deviceID: The identifier of the device to unregister. - Returns: `true` on success and `false` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncDeviceSetCustomProfiles
functions.doc: Sets custom profiles for a device in lieu of its factory profiles. The `profileInfo` dictionary requires the following keys: - ProfileIDs, which must be a subset of the ProfileIDs you registered the device with, or ``kColorSyncDeviceDefaultProfileID`` for setting a custom default profile. It requires the following values: - The `CFURLRef` of the profile to set as a custom profile. It may also include the following optional keys: - ``kColorSyncProfileHostScope``: The host scope of the profile; one of `kCFPreferencesCurrentHost` or `kCFPreferencesAnyHost`. If you don't specify it, the framework assumes `kCFPreferencesCurrentHost`. - ``kColorSyncProfileUserScope``: The user scope of the profile; one of `kCFPreferencesCurrentUser` or `kCFPreferencesAnyUser`. If you don't specify it, the framework assumes `kCFPreferencesCurrentUser`. - Note: Profile scope for custom profiles cannot exceed the scope of the factory profiles. - Note: There is only one host scope and user scope per dictionary (that is, per call). - Note: Pass `kCFNull` in lieu of the profile URL to unset the custom profile and reset the current profile to the factory profile. - Parameters: - deviceClass: The class of the device. - deviceID: The identifier of the device. - profileInfo: A `CFDictionary` containing the information about custom profiles to set in lieu of factory profiles. - Returns: `true` on success and `false` in case of failure.

functions.name: ColorSyncDeviceCopyDeviceInfo
functions.doc: Copies information about a device, resolved for the current host and current user. Returns a dictionary with the following keys and values resolved for the current host and current user: << kColorSyncDeviceClass                   {camera, display, printer, scanner} kColorSyncDeviceID                      {CFUUIDRef registered with ColorSync} kColorSyncDeviceDescription             {localized device description} kColorSyncFactoryProfiles  (dictionary) << {ProfileID}    (dictionary) << kColorSyncDeviceProfileURL      {CFURLRef or kCFNull} kColorSyncDeviceModeDescription {localized mode description} >> ... kColorSyncDeviceDefaultProfileID {ProfileID} >> kColorSyncCustomProfiles  (dictionary) << {ProfileID}    {CFURLRef or kCFNull} ... << kColorSyncDeviceUserScope              {kCFPreferencesAnyUser or kCFPreferencesCurrentUser} kColorSyncDeviceHostScope              {kCFPreferencesAnyHost or kCFPreferencesCurrentHost} >> - Parameters: - deviceClass: The class of the device. - devID: The identifier of the device. - Returns: A dictionary describing the device, or `NULL` if no matching device is registered.

functions.name: ColorSyncIterateDeviceProfiles
functions.doc: Iterates over the profiles registered for all devices, invoking a callback for each. - Parameters: - callBack: The callback to invoke for each registered device profile. - userInfo: Caller-supplied context passed through to the callback. Optional.

functions.name: ColorSyncAPIVersion
functions.doc: Returns the version of the ColorSync API. - Returns: The API version as a binary-coded decimal `uint32_t`. From most to least significant byte, the value encodes the major OS version, minor OS version, patch version, and API version — that is, `(major << 24) | (minor << 16) | (dot << 8) | (apiVersion & 0xFF)`.

externs.name: kColorSyncProfileComputerDomain
externs.doc: The profile domain for profiles shared by all users of the computer. On macOS, these profiles are in the `/Library/ColorSync/Profiles` folder.

externs.name: kColorSyncProfileUserDomain
externs.doc: The profile domain for the current user's profiles. On macOS, these profiles are in the `~/Library/ColorSync/Profiles` folder.

externs.name: kColorSyncDoNotSubstituteProfiles
externs.doc: An option that, when set to `kCFBooleanTrue`, skips substituting a matching system-provided profile.

externs.name: kColorSyncProfileCacheSeed
externs.doc: The current profile-cache seed (uint32_t), sent with ``kColorSyncProfileRepositoryChangeNotification``.

externs.name: kColorSyncWaitForCacheReply
externs.doc: An iteration option that waits for the profile cache to finish updating before returning.

externs.name: kColorSyncHeadroomAdaptiveGainCurveApplicationVersion
externs.doc: Application version (uint8_t). 3-bit field from ST 2094-50 Table C.1. Must be `0`; the framework rejects any other value.

externs.name: kColorSyncHeadroomAdaptiveGainCurveColorVolumeTransform
externs.doc: Top-level container (CFDictionaryRef) for the color volume transform. It may contain parameters for Headroom-Adaptive tone mapping or indicate usage of the Reference-White Tone Mapping Method. It allows for specifying a custom HDR Reference White luminance.

externs.name: kColorSyncCustomHDRReferenceWhite
externs.doc: Custom reference white luminance in nits (float), overriding the standard 203-nit reference white. Must be greater than `0`. The encoding has a resolution of 0.2 nits and a maximum of 10000 nits; the framework clamps values to that range.

externs.name: kColorSyncHeadroomAdaptiveToneMappingInfo
externs.doc: Container (CFDictionaryRef) for Headroom-Adaptive tone mapping parameters. Present when Headroom-Adaptive tone mapping is encoded. Contains ``kColorSyncBaselineHeadroomStops`` and either ``kColorSyncHeadroomAdaptiveGainCurveInfo`` or, when set to `kCFBooleanFalse`, indicates the Reference-White Tone Mapping Operator (RWTMO) method.

externs.name: kColorSyncBaselineHeadroomStops
externs.doc: Headroom of the source (baseline) curve in stops (log2) above reference white (float in the range [0.0, 6.0]).

externs.name: kColorSyncHeadroomAdaptiveGainCurveInfo
externs.doc: Container (CFDictionaryRef) for the adaptive gain curve data. Contains the alternate curve count, sharing flags, chromaticities, and the per-alternate curve info array. When set to `kCFBooleanFalse` instead of a CFDictionary, indicates the Reference-White Tone Mapping Operator (RWTMO) method.

externs.name: kColorSyncAlternateCurveCount
externs.doc: Number of alternate (tone-mapped) curves encoded in the metadata (uint8_t in the range [0, 4]). Each alternate targets a different display headroom.

externs.name: kColorSyncAlternateGainCurveInfo
externs.doc: CFArrayRef of per-alternate dictionaries. Count equals ``kColorSyncAlternateCurveCount``. Only present when the alternate curve count is greater than 0. See the alternate curve keys below.

externs.name: kColorSyncGainCurveChromaticities
externs.doc: Chromaticity primaries used to compute the driving signal for the gain curve. For standard primaries, pass a `CFNumberRef` (`uint8_t`): 0 = BT.709, 1 = Display P3, 2 = BT.2020. For custom primaries, pass a `CFArrayRef` of 8 `float` values encoding four xy chromaticity pairs in order R, G, B, white point; each component in [0, 1] with x + y ≤ 1. The framework rejects any numeric value other than 0, 1, or 2.

externs.name: kColorSyncCommonComponentMixing
externs.doc: CFBooleanRef indicating whether alternate curves share one component-mixing configuration. When true, all alternate curves share the component mixing configuration from array index 0, reducing bitstream size.

externs.name: kColorSyncCommonCurveParameters
externs.doc: CFBooleanRef indicating whether alternate curves share common gain-curve parameters. When true, all alternate curves share the gain curve x control points and slope interpolate flag from array index 0, reducing bitstream size.

externs.name: kColorSyncAlternateCurveHeadroomStops
externs.doc: Target headroom of this alternate curve in stops (log2) above reference white (float in the range [0.0, 6.0]). The renderer selects the closest alternate to the actual display headroom.

externs.name: kColorSyncComponentMix
externs.doc: Component mixing type (uint8_t) matching `component_mixing_value` in ST 2094-50. Determines how the framework derives the scalar driving signal from the RGB pixel: - 0 = MAX(R, G, B) - 1 = single component (the framework applies the gain curve to individual components) - 2 = luma_A (sum of 1/6 of each color channel and 1/2 of MAX(R, G, B)) - 3 = free-style (custom linear combination via ``kColorSyncComponentCoefficients``) Shared across all alternates from index 0 when ``kColorSyncCommonComponentMixing`` is true.

externs.name: kColorSyncComponentCoefficients
externs.doc: Sub-dictionary of custom linear-combination coefficients for free-style component mixing. Each present key contributes its value as a weight in: `signal = R*red + G*green + B*blue + MAX*maxRGB + MIN*minRGB + C*component`. Only present when `kColorSyncComponentMix == 3`.

externs.name: kColorSyncCoefficientRed
externs.doc: Weight for the red channel in the free-style component mixing sum.

externs.name: kColorSyncCoefficientGreen
externs.doc: Weight for the green channel in the free-style component mixing sum.

externs.name: kColorSyncCoefficientBlue
externs.doc: Weight for the blue channel in the free-style component mixing sum.

externs.name: kColorSyncCoefficientMaxRGB
externs.doc: Weight for the MAX(R,G,B) term in the free-style component mixing sum.

externs.name: kColorSyncCoefficientMinRGB
externs.doc: Weight for the MIN(R,G,B) term in the free-style component mixing sum.

externs.name: kColorSyncCoefficientComponent
externs.doc: Weight for the 'component' term in the free-style component mixing sum.

externs.name: kColorSyncMaxControlPointIndex
externs.doc: Index of the last control point (uint8_t, 0–31), i.e. the number of control points minus 1. Shared across all alternates from index 0 when ``kColorSyncCommonCurveParameters`` is true.

externs.name: kColorSyncInterpolateSlopes
externs.doc: CFBooleanRef controlling how the framework determines control-point slopes. When true, the framework computes slopes at control points by Piecewise Cubic Hermite Interpolating Polynomial from the X,Y control point coordinates, and you must omit ``kColorSyncControlPointSlopes``. When false, you must supply explicit slopes in ``kColorSyncControlPointSlopes`` (see below). Shared across all alternates from index 0 when ``kColorSyncCommonCurveParameters`` is true.

externs.name: kColorSyncControlPointsX
externs.doc: CFArrayRef of floats — the X-axis coordinates of the gain-curve control points. The coordinates are normalized by the reference white, so a value of `1.0` corresponds to the signal value at reference white. Shared across all alternates from index 0 when ``kColorSyncCommonCurveParameters`` is true.

externs.name: kColorSyncControlPointsY
externs.doc: CFArrayRef of floats — the Y-axis gain offsets at the control points. Values are in stops (float in the range [0.0, 6.0]) and must be non-negative; the framework infers the gain direction (expand vs. compress) from the relationship between this alternate's headroom and the baseline headroom.

externs.name: kColorSyncControlPointSlopes
externs.doc: CFArrayRef of floats — explicit tangent slopes at each control point, expressed as tan(slope_angle). Only present when ``kColorSyncInterpolateSlopes`` is false.

externs.name: kColorSyncProfile
externs.doc: A key for the profile object in a profile-sequence dictionary passed to ``ColorSyncTransformCreate``.

externs.name: kColorSyncRenderingIntent
externs.doc: A key for the rendering intent to use for the profile in a profile-sequence dictionary.

externs.name: kColorSyncRenderingIntentPerceptual
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncRenderingIntent`` value selecting the perceptual rendering intent.

externs.name: kColorSyncRenderingIntentRelative
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncRenderingIntent`` value selecting the media-relative colorimetric rendering intent.

externs.name: kColorSyncRenderingIntentSaturation
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncRenderingIntent`` value selecting the saturation rendering intent.

externs.name: kColorSyncRenderingIntentAbsolute
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncRenderingIntent`` value selecting the ICC-absolute colorimetric rendering intent.

externs.name: kColorSyncRenderingIntentUseProfileHeader
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncRenderingIntent`` value selecting the rendering intent stored in the profile header.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformTag
externs.doc: A key for the tag identifying which tags of the profile to use in a profile-sequence dictionary.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformDeviceToPCS
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncTransformTag`` value selecting the device-to-PCS conversion direction.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformPCSToPCS
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncTransformTag`` value selecting the PCS-to-PCS conversion direction.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformPCSToDevice
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncTransformTag`` value selecting the PCS-to-device conversion direction.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformDeviceToDevice
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncTransformTag`` value selecting the device-to-device conversion direction.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformGamutCheck
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncTransformTag`` value that checks whether colors fall outside the destination gamut.

externs.name: kColorSyncBlackPointCompensation
externs.doc: A key whose `CFBooleanRef` value enables or disables black point compensation.

externs.name: kColorSyncExtendedRange
externs.doc: A key whose `CFBooleanRef` value enables or disables extended range.

externs.name: kColorSyncHDRDerivative
externs.doc: A key for the HDR derivative to apply to the profile in a profile-sequence dictionary.

externs.name: kColorSyncPQDerivative
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncHDRDerivative`` value selecting the PQ HDR derivative.

externs.name: kColorSyncHLGDerivative
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncHDRDerivative`` value selecting the HLG HDR derivative.

externs.name: kColorSyncPreferredCMM
externs.doc: A key whose value is the ``ColorSyncCMMRef`` of the preferred CMM.

externs.name: kColorSyncConvertQuality
externs.doc: A key for the quality of the conversion performed by the transform.

externs.name: kColorSyncBestQuality
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncConvertQuality`` value that does not coalesce profile transforms; the default.

externs.name: kColorSyncNormalQuality
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncConvertQuality`` value that coalesces all transforms.

externs.name: kColorSyncDraftQuality
externs.doc: A ``kColorSyncConvertQuality`` value that coalesces all transforms and does not interpolate.

externs.name: kColorSyncConvertUseExtendedRange
externs.doc: A key whose `CFBooleanRef` value allows float data to exceed the `[0.0, 1.0]` range.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformInfo
externs.doc: A key for a dictionary of information about the transform.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformCreator
externs.doc: A key for the name of the CMM that created the transform.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformSrcSpace
externs.doc: A key for the transform's source color space.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformDstSpace
externs.doc: A key for the transform's destination color space.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformCodeFragmentType
externs.doc: A key for the type of code fragment to create, or that the framework created.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformCodeFragmentMD5
externs.doc: A key for the MD5 checksum of the code fragment.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformFullConversionData
externs.doc: A key for the full-conversion code fragment, containing all non-`NULL` components from the profile sequence.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformSimplifiedConversionData
externs.doc: A key for the simplified code fragment, collapsing the full conversion into one multi-dimensional table.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformParametricConversionData
externs.doc: A key for the parametric code fragment, consisting only of parametric curves, matrices, and BPC components.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformProfileSequnce
externs.doc: A key for the profile sequence used to create the transform.

externs.name: kColorSyncTransformUseITU709OETF
externs.doc: A key whose `CFBooleanRef` value uses the ITU-R BT.709 opto-electronic transfer function.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversionMatrix
externs.doc: A key for a conversion matrix component, represented as a `CFArray` of three `CFArray`s of four `Float32` `CFNumber`s.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversionParamCurve0
externs.doc: A key for a parametric tone rendering curve of type 0, represented as a `CFArray` of seven `Float32` `CFNumber`s.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversionParamCurve1
externs.doc: A key for a parametric tone rendering curve of type 1, represented as a `CFArray` of seven `Float32` `CFNumber`s.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversionParamCurve2
externs.doc: A key for a parametric tone rendering curve of type 2, represented as a `CFArray` of seven `Float32` `CFNumber`s.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversionParamCurve3
externs.doc: A key for a parametric tone rendering curve of type 3, represented as a `CFArray` of seven `Float32` `CFNumber`s.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversionParamCurve4
externs.doc: A key for a parametric tone rendering curve of type 4, represented as a `CFArray` of seven `Float32` `CFNumber`s.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversion1DLut
externs.doc: A key for a one-dimensional lookup table with interpolation, represented as `CFData` containing a `Float32` table.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversionGridPoints
externs.doc: A key for the number of grid points in a lookup table.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversionChannelID
externs.doc: A key for the identifier of the channel a conversion component applies to.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversion3DLut
externs.doc: A key for a three-dimensional lookup table with interpolation, represented as `CFData`.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversionNDLut
externs.doc: A key for a multi-dimensional lookup table with interpolation, represented as `CFData` for N inputs and M outputs.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversionInpChan
externs.doc: A key for the number of input channels of a lookup table.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversionOutChan
externs.doc: A key for the number of output channels of a lookup table.

externs.name: kColorSyncConversionBPC
externs.doc: A key for a black point compensation component, represented as a `CFArray` of `Float32` `CFNumber`s.

externs.name: kColorSyncFixedPointRange
externs.doc: A key for the fixed-point range of the conversion data.

externs.name: kCMMInitializeLinkProfileProcName
externs.doc: The CMM bundle info-dictionary key whose value is the name of the function that initializes a device-link profile.

externs.name: kCMMInitializeTransformProcName
externs.doc: The CMM bundle info-dictionary key whose value is the name of the function that initializes a color transform.

externs.name: kCMMApplyTransformProcName
externs.doc: The CMM bundle info-dictionary key whose value is the name of the function that applies a color transform.

externs.name: kCMMCreateTransformPropertyProcName
externs.doc: The CMM bundle info-dictionary key whose value is the name of the function that creates a transform property.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceID
externs.doc: A key whose value is the `CFUUIDRef` identifying the device.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceClass
externs.doc: A key whose value is one of the device-class constants below.

externs.name: kColorSyncCameraDeviceClass
externs.doc: The device class for a camera device. The string that represents a camera device is `cmra`.

externs.name: kColorSyncDisplayDeviceClass
externs.doc: The device class for a display device. The string that represents a display device is `mntr`.

externs.name: kColorSyncPrinterDeviceClass
externs.doc: The device class for a printer device. The string that represents a printer device is `prtr`.

externs.name: kColorSyncScannerDeviceClass
externs.doc: The device class for a scanner device. The string that represents a scanner device is `scnr`.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceProfileURL
externs.doc: A key whose value is the `CFURLRef` of a device profile.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceDescription
externs.doc: A key whose value is the device's localized name in the current locale.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceDescriptions
externs.doc: A key whose value is a `CFDictionary` of the device's localized names.

externs.name: kColorSyncFactoryProfiles
externs.doc: A key whose value is a `CFDictionary` describing the device's factory profiles.

externs.name: kColorSyncCustomProfiles
externs.doc: A key whose value is a `CFDictionary` describing the device's custom profiles.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceModeDescription
externs.doc: A key whose value is the device mode's localized name in the current locale.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceModeDescriptions
externs.doc: A key whose value is a `CFDictionary` of the device mode's localized names.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceDefaultProfileID
externs.doc: A key whose value is the ProfileID of the device's default profile.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceHostScope
externs.doc: A key specifying the host preference scope of a device; currently only `kCFPreferencesCurrentHost` is supported.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceUserScope
externs.doc: A key specifying the user preference scope of a device; one of `kCFPreferencesCurrentUser` or `kCFPreferencesAnyUser`.

externs.name: kColorSyncProfileHostScope
externs.doc: A key specifying the host preference scope of a profile; currently only `kCFPreferencesCurrentHost` is supported.

externs.name: kColorSyncProfileUserScope
externs.doc: A key specifying the user preference scope of a profile; one of `kCFPreferencesCurrentUser` or `kCFPreferencesAnyUser`.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceProfileIsFactory
externs.doc: A key in the device-profile-info dictionary whose value indicates whether the profile is a factory profile.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceProfileIsDefault
externs.doc: A key in the device-profile-info dictionary whose value indicates whether the profile is the default profile.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceProfileIsCurrent
externs.doc: A key in the device-profile-info dictionary whose value indicates whether the profile is the current profile.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceProfileID
externs.doc: A key in the device-profile-info dictionary whose value is the profile's ProfileID.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceRegisteredNotification
externs.doc: A notification that ColorSync posts when a device is registered.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceUnregisteredNotification
externs.doc: A notification that ColorSync posts when a device is unregistered.

externs.name: kColorSyncDeviceProfilesNotification
externs.doc: A notification that ColorSync posts when a device's profiles change.

externs.name: kColorSyncDisplayDeviceProfilesNotification
externs.doc: A notification that ColorSync posts when a display device's profiles change.

externs.name: kColorSyncProfileRepositoryChangeNotification
externs.doc: A notification that ColorSync posts when the profile repository changes.

externs.name: kColorSyncRegistrationUpdateWindowServer
externs.doc: A notification concerning the window server's device registration.
